title: Origin Morph Drawer
summary: The menu button opens a full-screen panel that grows as a circle from the button's centre, with large links rising in one after another.
useWhen: Full-screen navigation for a festival, venue or event site with few top-level pages
Mobile-first menu where the button sits in a corner and the panel should feel tied to it
Studio or agency site that wants a bold colour moment when the menu opens
Replacing a side drawer that slides in from an edge unrelated to the button
techniques: clip-path circle() from measured button centre
per-item transition-delay from a custom property
focus trap with a Tab ring

whyItWorks.how: On open the script measures the button and sets --cx, --cy and --r, where --r is the distance to the farthest viewport corner. The panel's clip-path goes from circle(0px at cx cy) to circle(r at cx cy), so it grows out of the button and shrinks back into it.

Open and close are plain CSS transitions on clip-path and transform, so a second click mid-flight reverses from the current radius. In testing a close issued 150ms into the open took the circle from about 1216px back down without a jump. Input is never locked.

Opening takes 620ms (--open-duration) on an ease-out and closing takes 420ms (--close-duration) on an ease-in. Links leave together in 200ms with no stagger, so dismissing the menu never waits on the last item.
Links rise 140ms after the circle starts, 50ms apart (--link-stagger), so the fifth link starts at 340ms while the circle is still settling. The footer fades in last at 380ms.

The button and links are real elements with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Focus moves to the first link on open, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle through the button and links only, Escape closes and returns focus to the button, and the page behind is inert.

directions.name: Minimal
directions.change: Use an off-white panel with ink links at 40px, drop the link numbers, and shorten the open to 480ms.

directions.name: Luxury
directions.change: Use a deep green or black panel, set the links in a light serif, slow the stagger to 70ms, and fade the footer in after the last link lands.

directions.name: Brutalist
directions.change: Swap the circle for clip-path: inset() growing from the button's corner, use a monospaced uppercase link list, and cut every duration by a third.

pitfalls: Hard-coding the circle origin. The button moves between breakpoints, so measure it on open and on resize.
Using a radius such as 100vmax that is too small for some aspect ratios. Compute the distance to the farthest corner.
Toggling visibility or display at the end of the close with a timer. A quick reopen then fights the timer. Keep the panel rendered, clipped to zero and inert.
Staggering the exit as well as the entrance. People closing a menu want it gone, so leave together.
Forgetting the page behind. Without inert on the main content, Tab walks out of the open menu into hidden links.

tunables.name: --open-duration
tunables.effect: How long the circle takes to cover the screen.

tunables.name: --close-duration
tunables.effect: How long the circle takes to shrink back into the button.

tunables.name: --link-stagger
tunables.effect: Delay between each link rising into view.

tunables.name: --ease-out
tunables.effect: Curve for the opening circle and the links.

tunables.name: --ease-in
tunables.effect: Curve for the closing circle and the links leaving.

reducedMotion: The panel fades in over 200ms and out over 160ms with no circle growth. Links are in place without rising, and the button label and icon change without moving.
